Execution_Integrity also has meaningful independent support, since it repeatedly converts upstream anomaly/deviation configurations into 'Normal', which can directly mislead final diagnosis. Other candidates are less well supported: Network_Manipulation has limited counts and may reflect upstream evidence ambiguity; Program_Anomaly has substantial success overlap; Root_Causes appears more likely to inherit errors from upstream misclassification than to be independently flawed based on the available statistics.

cpt_danger_report.overall_summary: Execution_Integrity and Root_Causes are the only CPTs with sufficiently strong independent evidence for refinement. Other candidates are not independently convincing: Program_Anomaly is moderately failure-associated but has success overlap and may simply reflect missing upstream evidence; Deviation_in_Dispatch is too balanced between failures and successes to justify refinement; Network_Manipulation has limited evidence and is likely secondary to downstream decision mappings.

If this CPT too readily outputs Program_Anomaly=No when GPTN_3 is Not_Found, it can suppress compromise evidence and distort downstream execution-integrity reasoning across multiple failures.

In this domain, absence of inconsistent log evidence does not reliably prove absence of program anomaly because logs may be imperfect or incomplete. The repeated failure pattern suggests this strong negative mapping may be causing under-detection of program anomalies, which then feeds into incorrect Execution_Integrity and final root-cause predictions.

cpt_danger_report.overall_summary: Execution_Integrity and Program_Anomaly are the only CPTs with strong enough independent evidence for refinement search. Both lie on the same repeated failure path, but each has its own plausible modeling issue: Program_Anomaly may overinterpret missing log inconsistency as evidence of normality, and Execution_Integrity may overinterpret dispatch-only deviation evidence as compromise even when program anomaly and response deviation are absent. Network_Manipulation and Root_Causes were not included because their evidence is weaker and more plausibly explained by upstream reasoning errors rather than independent CPT flaws.
